name: Granola
tagline: AI notepad for meetings — summarizes and organizes what matters
verdictSummary: Transcribe → summarize → store is a well-trodden AI pipeline. One GPT-4o-mini prompt handles real-time transcription, another summarizes by topic. Local storage via IndexedDB.
coreLoopDIY: Real-time transcription + AI summary + searchable history
whyPeopleStillPay: Teams that need shared meeting notes with calendar sync
notes: One of the highest-voted apps on the site. The prompt is battle-tested.
